[[Commerce Advisor]] '''Rue''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrat]]. Stationed on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], Rue heard rumors of an impending [[Miner/Legends|miners]] strike and believed that there was more to [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] than anyone realized.<ref name="Game" />
